answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1816 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the saffron. The knoll index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the zephyr queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
